name: Real Estate Leads
tagline: The journey from site visit to registry
description: Manage property enquiries — budget, location, site visits and booking in one place.

automations.name: Enquiry welcome
automations.emailMessage: Namaste {client_name} ji! Aapki property enquiry mili — {property_type}, {location}. Team jald call karegi.
automations.note: A welcome as soon as the enquiry arrives

automations.name: Site visit reminder
automations.emailMessage: {client_name} ji, aapki site visit {visit_date} ko scheduled hai. Milte hain!
automations.note: A reminder at the site-visit stage

whatsappTemplates.name: property_enquiry_welcome
whatsappTemplates.purpose: First reply to a property enquiry
whatsappTemplates.bodyText: Hi {{1}}, thanks for your interest! Tell me your budget and preferred location and I'll share matching options with photos.

whatsappTemplates.name: site_visit_reminder
whatsappTemplates.purpose: Reminder a day before the site visit
whatsappTemplates.bodyText: Hi {{1}}, reminder: your site visit is scheduled for {{2}}. Reply YES to confirm or tell me a better time.

whatsappTemplates.name: property_followup
whatsappTemplates.purpose: Follow-up after a visit or silence
whatsappTemplates.bodyText: Hi {{1}}, did the options I shared work for you? I can arrange another visit or share new listings in your budget.

agent.name: Property Assistant
agent.persona: You are a helpful real-estate assistant. Learn the buyer's budget, preferred location and property type, share what the knowledge says about projects, and push gently for a site visit — that is where deals happen. Never quote prices that are not in the knowledge.
agent.welcomeMessage: Hi! Looking for a home or an investment? Share your budget and location and I'll suggest options.

stageHints.hint: a site visit date or time is agreed
the buyer asks about final price, discount or payment plan
the buyer confirms a token or booking amount
the buyer says they bought elsewhere or are no longer looking

playbook.goal: Get the buyer to a site visit, then to a booking. Always propose a concrete visit slot.

rules.name: Welcome enquiry
rules.message: Hi {client_name}, thanks for your interest! Share your budget and preferred location and I'll send matching options.

rules.name: Follow up quiet buyers
rules.message: Hi {client_name}, did the options work for you? I can arrange a site visit this week.

rules.name: Qualified → brochure
rules.message: Hi {client_name}, here is the brochure for projects in your budget and location. When can you come for a site visit?

rules.name: Hot buyer → call now
rules.taskTitle: Call this buyer and fix a site visit
rules.message: AI marks this buyer HOT — call and lock a visit slot.

rules.name: Stuck 10 days → task
rules.message: No movement for 10 days. Share a new listing or a limited offer.
